# Starter dashboard

This placeholder demonstrates a dashboard with **XLSX action-file delivery**.

- `Field_Team` receives the open-cases worklist.
- `Data_Team` receives the open-cases worklist and a data-review worklist.
- The public dashboard is delivered separately from restricted action files.

Replace this page and `generate_mock_data.py` with your own Quarto analysis.
